entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Welcome to the House of Darkness,[n]our puzzling labyrinth in the dark.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You better not be lookin' for a fight.[n]We ain't interested!

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: *chuckle* That won't be necessary.[n]You are valuable participants, after all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Participants?

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Most certainly. The original intent behind[n]the high limit floor is different from that[n]of others.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: On this floor, VIPs are encouraged[n]to send substitutes to compete in[n]the games in their place.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Consider it to be like the horses in[n]horse racing. However... it seems[n]you have no substitutes.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Of course we don't. That should be[n]obvious.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Indeed it is!

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Hence, you will be the vital participants[n]in these games.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...So we basically need to be our own[n]substitutes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Eh, sounds perfect to me! That's way[n]better than spectating!

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Splendid! Now, allow me to explain the[n]rules. A straightforward maze lies directly[n]ahead of you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: I suggest you exercise utmost caution[n]within, as the lighting is dimmed quite[n]heavily.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Your entry fee into this maze will be[n][clr 2]1,000[clr 27] coins...

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: But if you can manage to reach the[n]goal, well... you will obtain [clr 2]ten times[clr 27][n]that amount.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: 10,000 coins, just from completing[n]a maze!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It is no wonder they call this the high[n]limit floor. I doubt the maze will be as[n]simple as it sounds...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Either way, our first move will need[n]to be gaining the entry fee.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: According to this Shadow, we'll need[n][clr 2]1,000[clr 27] coins.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: Please come speak to me if you wish to[n]participate. I will be behind that counter[n]over there.
Let's start.
I'll come back later.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: One more thing: you are free to head[n]backward in the maze or even leave[n]the room if you so choose.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: ...Well then, please enjoy.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: My, how unfortunate. Please come by[n]if you change your mind.

entries.speaker: Shadow Attendant
entries.en: I will be waiting for you behind that[n]counter. Until next time...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're free to leave if we want?[n]This is sounding more suspicious[n]by the second...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God damn! It's so freakin' dark!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is definitely not "a little."[n]We've been tricked.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm sensing Shadows too. "Very simple,"[n]my ass.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If we do not ascertain the layout and[n]placement of the enemies, we will[n]surely find ourselves in danger.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I just hope there is an adequate way[n]of doing so...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oooh, we made it through!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is that it though? It feels like there's[n]more up ahead.
